title: SCHC receiver size limits accept impossible values above profile capacity
description: Final correctness review after cc0v: FragmentReceiver validates max_size only as a positive exact integer, while ReassemblyManager rejects values above 2*WINDOW_SIZE*TILE_SIZE (22,554). Internal _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager does not validate max_size at all. A direct receiver configured above the fixed two-window profile silently advertises/enforces a limit the wire format can never reach, and the authenticated owner can be misconfigured similarly. Centralize exact 1..MAX_PACKET_SIZE validation for every receiver owner and add MAX_PACKET_SIZE / MAX_PACKET_SIZE+1 tests.
acceptance_criteria: All reassembly constructors reject bool/fractional/zero and values above MAX_PACKET_SIZE consistently; exact upper boundary passes.
